oracle_kind: first full earthquake cycle (Q0): interseismic loading, nucleation, rupture, postseismic decay

event.note: global.dat column 2 is linear m/s for bp != 8 (globaldat(2,it) = maxSlipRate, written raw). Only the BP8 .dat writer applies dlog10. Do not exponentiate it.

provenance.note: nstep raised to 100000 so the cycle exits on its own criterion rather than a step cap; nt_out = 1000

caveat: regression lock, not a physics validation. The cycle length depends on hang_time = 1e5 s, hardcoded in solveTimeLoopMUMPS.f90 with the comment 'subjective to change', not on a compset parameter -- changing it moves this oracle.
